changes_from_v1: 2026-10-11 hardening (docs/audits/2026-10-11-blackswan/2-overfitting.md): 1.6 trial count = max(dsr_inputs.trials, provenance.trials.count + battery candidates, research-service ledger count for the kind) + others, trials ledger cross-check, V[SR] floor; 1.13 synthetic-view cap enforced by AlphaKeel; 1.14 review-credential only, min_closed 5 -> 20, unregistered runs and OOS window reuse fail; 1.15 same pack as the IS pack; 1.16 null pack_accept_partial fails; 3.10 counts every same-kind strategy that ever entered paper; new information-only 3.11. Strategies registered under v1 keep their own v1 copy (thresholds are not retroactive). 2.1 (blackswan fix program, 3-survivorship-pit P0-1 and 2-overfitting P1-7): new 1.18 research-universe point-in-time-ness (data lock universe.selection / universe.survivorship; a universe that does not exclude survivors caps the G1 grade at C), new 1.19 undeclared numeric literals (provenance.fixed_literals), 1.9 also checks the relative width of every robust interval itself (>= 0.2); strategies registered under v2 or v1 keep their own copy (1.18 / 1.19 are optional items). 2.2 (research/judgement review 2026-10-11, docs/audits/2026-10-11-blackswan/review-research.md): AlphaKeel judges instead of reading the researcher's self-report. 1.3-1.5 also need the research service's own conservative-fill net (service_runs verified against the service run records, which also fix the IS pack); 1.6 counts fixed_literals, the ledger excludes review-credential runs and other lineages, a broken ledger fails, and service_runs must be registered and verified; 1.9 every side of every robust interval at least 20% (identical in the VT precheck); 1.12 permutation test forced when the IR restricts its universe (excluded_bases, bases whitelist the battery traded outside of); 1.13 synthetic-quote cap from the IS pack data lock; 1.14 only conservative-fill validations (spread floor >= 5 bp on synthetic quotes, capital cost charged, net_of_capital_cost, fees_override not below the account fee), the OOS consumption account counts every review-credential run of the same lineage whether registered or not; 1.18 a survivor side (survivors_*, partial_from_archive) is a direct FAIL (no more PASS-but-cap-C), 1.18 / 1.19 are required items from 2.1 on; 1.19 exemptions by position not by value; 3.6 baseline includes the conservative extra cost. Strategies registered under 2.1 or earlier keep their own copy. 2.4 (financial-grade audit 2026-10-11, F06-F10): 3.1 counts only FULL UTC days (no gap between consecutive marks above max_gap_hours = 1 h, boundaries included; a short outage only costs the day), and fails the whole incubation when any outage (gap between marks, head gap, tail age) exceeds max_outage_hours = 24 h; paper daily returns never difference across calendar gaps (non-contiguous pairs are dropped and counted); 3.9 requires the matched scan-frame IR-ledger replays of THIS strategy to cover every input frame (seq range) the paper journal's marks used (an uncovered tail is allowed only if its first mark is at most max_outage_hours old), with no hole and no mismatching replay inside it, AND compares event by event: each validation segment starts flat on the paper side, open/close events (seq, kind, pair) match exactly, funding events match on (settlement time, pair) and amount; of overlapping validations only the latest recorded one counts; 1.6 DSR and 1.8 bootstrap are also recomputed from the research service run's own daily equity (must pass on both; both lower bounds, reported and recomputed, must be above the threshold and are shown separately); review-credential validations count only when the research service lists the same run_id and credential_id; 1.7/1.9-1.11 stay as reported by VT, not recomputed. Strategies registered under 2.3 or earlier keep their own copy; the new 3.1 / 3.9 keys are back-filled (AK_SIDE_KEYS). 2.5 (end-to-end audit 2026-10-12, user decision U-D 2026-10-13: 04 WP2 / WP5 / WP7 / WP8 and 02 WP5): G3 is evaluated only at the checkpoints of the incubation plan recorded before the paper start (plan days, plus at most max_extensions pre-registered extensions of extension_days each; a verdict outside a checkpoint window of checkpoint_window_days fails, after the last one the incubation has expired); the significance of 3.4 and 3.10 is split over the planned looks (Pocock: confidence / min DSR 0.95 for one look, 0.9706 for two, 0.9779 for three) and both use only the full-day returns up to the current checkpoint; 3.5 / 3.7 / B1 compare the paper series gross of the capital cost with the gross service baseline (3.3 / 3.4 / 3.10 stay net of the capital cost charged on the whole capital base); B2 applies at any positive backtest frequency with a gap scaled to it; 2.3 requires plan days that cover the expected 30 closed trades; 1.14 counts a validation as information-enforced out of sample only when its window starts at or after max(research horizon, the strategy's registration), a historical holdout is service-enforced and caps the G1 grade at B, the research horizon includes provenance.data_exposure_end_ms (non-service data reads recorded by VT), the IR's provenance.research_credential must be known to the research service, and waived decision blockers pass only when every waiver starts with a protocol waivable_blockers prefix (listed on the card); 1.9 needs both the lo and the hi neighbour of every parameter; 1.12 needs at least min_permutations draws with the seed AlphaKeel derives from the strategy id; 3.9 compares per-trade economics and the segment end equity (the research service emits them again). Strategies registered under 2.4 or earlier keep their own copy; the new AlphaKeel-side keys are back-filled (AK_SIDE_KEYS), the waivable_blockers allow-list is not (an older copy waives nothing).
note: Thresholds are decimal strings; a ratio threshold is {"num": n, "den": d} and compares exactly (no rounding). Canonical home: docs/contracts/validation/protocol.json (exported to VT with the research contract, pinned). Every item id is implemented in crates/strategy-registry/src/verdict.rs; an unknown or missing id makes the protocol invalid (fail closed). VT's research-side precheck (agent/alphakeel_research/precheck.py) reads the same file from the exported contract and evaluates only the items marked research_side.
